summary: The References credit `GeneralLinear.Borel` for the point-subgroup construction, but the Points section is a close, name-for-name adaptation of `SpecialLinear/Basic.lean`, which goes unnamed; `GeneralLinear.Borel` is instead the model for the maximality proof. Everything else (Milne/Carter, `SL2Borel.le_of_isSolvable_of_infinite`) is properly credited.
